note:
daryl: the polis default, offered as a light theme (Vincent, 2026-11-16: "it's not horrible"). Named for D.A.R.Y.L. (1985), the Data Analyzing Robot Youth Lifeform: an ordinary face, a dependable boy, something cleverer underneath. polis's agents never pass for human; this one only lends the default its name (Vincent, 2026-11-18, renamed from classic).
It starts as the default's own values and sets nothing; the default itself stays frozen with onboarding.
